sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "systemperformance"."devlink" AS e, "users"."typelabel" AS g, SUM("systemperformance"."errcount") AS m1, AVG("systemperformance"."warncount") AS m2 FROM "systemperformance" JOIN "devices" ON "devices"."devkey" = "systemperformance"."devlink" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "devices"."uselink" GROUP BY "systemperformance"."devlink", "users"."typelabel"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, (CAST(AVG("s1"."m1") AS REAL) / AVG("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s2"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s2"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s2"
construction: agg:devices within users.typelabel > agg:g > ratio > agg:all
why: total of errors per devices within users.typelabel (additive)
average of warnings per devices within users.typelabel
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
average of total of errors relative to average of average of warnings: both in count of performance records, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
